title: Pricing Flex Pools and Auto-TrueUp Reconciliation Playbook
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Objective: Define and test a bounded 'Flex Pool' add-on and an automated True-Up reconciliation flow to reduce renewal friction for mid-market and enterprise customers while preserving predictable revenue and acceptable overage recovery.

Background: We frequently see customers under- or over-commiting at renewal. Current true-up processes are manual and cause delays: sales/CS must negotiate credits, finance issues one-off invoices, and customers report surprise charges. Existing multi-year discounts are blunt instruments that don't adapt to variable usage patterns. The Flex Pool is a modest, pre-purchased buffer (percentage of committed tokens or a fixed token pool) that reduces the need for immediate true-up conversations and smooths expansion paths. An automated True-Up Reconciliation at quarter boundary would apply standardized credit/charge rules and surface exceptions for CS review.

Proposed experiment: Offer two Flex Pool variants on renewal (Percent Flex = 20% of committed spend at a lower uplift; Fixed Flex = 50M tokens at tiered price) and enable an opt-in Auto-TrueUp that executes a reconciliation script 30 days after quarter close. Customers can elect to have the true-up auto-invoiced or routed to a CS review queue.

Hypothesis: A Flex Pool product + Auto-TrueUp reduces renewal negotiation time by 30%, lowers CS touch rate for overage disputes by 40%, and increases expansion conversion (upsell within 90 days) by 8% for accounts with >$25k ARR. Net revenue effect should be neutral-to-positive after adjusting uplift pricing.

Success metrics (tracked in Gainsight/Looker):
- Renewal negotiation lead time (days) pre/post
- CS Overage dispute rate (tickets per 100 renewals)
- % of accounts auto-reconciled vs routed to review
- Expansion conversion within 90 days for flex pool customers
- Net ARR delta attributable to flex pools (gross uplift - forgone overage)

Rollout plan:
1) Internal alignment & legal template update (2 weeks) — define contract language for Flex Pool, auto-invoicing consent, cancellation rights.
2) Billing & backend changes (3 sprints) — schema for flex pool on contract, reconciliation job, invoice generation path, accounting-ledgers mapping. ENG scope: schema, reconciliation worker, audit logs, edge-case idempotency.
3) Sales/CS pilot (4 accounts initially) — select 4 high-fit accounts in mid-market to pilot and collect qualitative feedback.
4) Observability & dashboards — tracking reconciliation outcomes, disputes, and revenue mapping.
5) Broader beta to 50 accounts if pilot metrics hold.

Key trade-offs and constraints:
- Product simplicity vs accounting accuracy: introducing flex pools complicates billing logic and recognition. Work with Finance to ensure revenue recognition rules are clear.
- Price sensitivity: too aggressive uplift makes flex pool unattractive; too conservative erodes revenue. We'll iterate pricing in small A/B cohorts.
- Legal/regulatory: auto-invoicing requires clear consent and opt-out mechanisms; ensure enterprise SQ answers updated.

Implementation notes:
- Back-end will store two fields on contract: flex_pool_type (percent|fixed|none) and flex_pool_size (tokens or percent).
- Reconciliation job runs monthly but applies adjustments quarterly. It should generate a reconciliation summary PDF attached to the invoice and create a ticket in CS if variance > configured threshold.
- Provide an API endpoint for customers to query current flex pool utilization and projected reconciliation amount.

Links & artifacts:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PRIC/Flex+Pool+Playbook
- Draft contract language (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-flexpool-contract
- Billing PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/782
- Pilot selection doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/0pilot-flexpool-selection

Legal notes: Contract team flagged auto-invoicing opt-in language and recommended an explicit opt-in checkbox plus 30-day prior notice before the first auto-charge. Finance requested a sub-ledger for flex pool transactions to simplify recognition and audit.
acceptance_criteria: Billing schema supports flex_pool_type and flex_pool_size on contract records
Reconciliation worker runs and produces invoice adjustments and a reconciliation summary PDF for pilot accounts
CS queue receives flagged exceptions (>10% variance) with links to invoice and reconciliation summary
Sales collateral and one-pager for enablement completed and reviewed by GTM
Pilot launched with 4 accounts and initial signals captured in Looker dashboard
